爱莎贝儿娃主返图-140CM-M 白肤 AHR015 赤坂香织Akasaka Kaori-束带少女装 by 吼姆拉
拆开快递，我人傻了。
这哪是女仆装，就几根带子！
他眼睛亮晶晶地等着夸。
看着手里省布料的“礼物”，我沉默了整整十秒。
我深吸一口气，挤出笑：“宝贝…你眼光真特别哈。”
“喜欢吗？”他问。
我听见自己平静的声音：“喜欢，今晚你穿给我看，我就更喜欢了。”
身型：140CM-M 白肤

Elsa Babe doll owner's photo sharing-140CM-M White AHR015 Akasaka Kaori-Bound Girl Outfit by Houmura
When I opened the package, I was stunned.
This isn't a maid outfit, it's just a few straps!
His eyes lit up, waiting for praise.
Looking at the "gift" that saved fabric in my hand, I remained silent for a full ten seconds.
I took a deep breath and forced a smile: "Honey...you have really good taste."
"Do you like it?" he asked.
I heard my own calm voice: "I like it. I'll like it even more if you wear it for me tonight."
Body type: 140CM-M with White skin tone.
